title: Cataclysm 0.9 — Living Horde (first bounded update)
prompt:
FIRST OF TWO AUTHORIZED EXTRA CATACLYSM 0.9 UPDATE RUNS. KEEP CATACLYSM 0.9 (do not create 1.0, do not quietly change user-visible/runtime version), with a unique internal build ID and the same stable /preview/ game URL. Continue from the latest live 0.9 source and preserve permanent companions, active Burst/Heal/Guard, squad tactics, relics, roguelite XP/upgrades, landscape one-screen controls, existing enemy species and Alley King boss. Do NOT touch the Game Studio, dashboard, workflows or other games; do NOT reread previous private recordings. Player wants an autonomous, thoughtful studio, not a mechanical implementation of every suggestion.

CORE DIRECTIVE: THE LIVING HORDE. Implement a coherent, bounded enemy-threat director that responds to actual player effectiveness and the CURRENT ALIVE ENEMY POPULATION, rather than just elapsed time and simplistic speed/hp scaling. Track some stable signals: rolling kill rate or damage per second, recent survival time, level/build effectiveness, nearby density, active enemy threat-weight budget and cooldown to prevent oscillation. Strong play should earn rewarding challenge/new enemies, not be punished by instant lethal spikes. Suppress excessive spawns when threat budget is full; replenish when the field is cleared, but enforce a minimum and maximum spawn delay, maximum live enemies and frame-time safety. Use hysteresis/smoothing and recovery windows. Existing enemy types and five-minute boss should still work.

EXPANSION: Integrate the deferred 0.9 engineer proposal for differentiated LATE-GAME ENEMY MUTATIONS if it fits safely. After meaningful progression, rare enemies can gain one of several visually telegraphed behaviors such as speed burst, temporary shield or irregular movement, each with distinct counters and finite duration. The studio should select and implement a small coherent set; avoid mutation spam, unavoidable death, invisible attacks and all-at-once power scaling. Encounters must visually communicate what is happening; readably telegraph dashes and shields. Refine existing pacing, hit reactions and game readability if needed, without disabling existing playable systems.

EXPERIMENTAL STUDIO AUTONOMY: Producer/Researcher/Designer/Critic/Engineer should evaluate current code, tradeoffs and interactions; choose the simplest substantive mechanics with measurable results; leave rejected hypotheses and deferred risks in the usual output. This is a complete playable code update, not only a plan, docs or UI copy.

ACCEPTANCE: Independent long-run deterministic simulations for 0-12+ minutes covering early easy play, high DPS, low DPS, crowded fields, boss, multiple mutated enemies, upgrade events, and spawn rate/threat caps. Check frame/performance pressure against bounded object counts, death not inevitable due to instantaneous over-spawn, and each mutation has visible telegraph and expires. Test touch drag/start/pause/resume/restart, rune and active companion abilities, all 3 upgrade choice controls and landscape 640x320 / 844x390 plus portrait fallback. QA must verify actual live game and dashboard bytes; fail closed on essential faults, never replace accepted 0.9 without validated source.
acceptance: User-facing version, expected boot version and runtime BUILD stay 0.9; unique technical build marker and stable /preview/ URL.
A measurable adaptive threat director considers alive enemy population and smoothed player effectiveness or survival signals, with documented threat/spawn budget, floor/ceiling and hysteresis.
Deterministic tests demonstrate sensible early-, high-DPS-, low-DPS-, and crowded-field spawn behavior, not just new numerical configuration.

At least two clearly distinguishable rare enemy mutations or equivalent late-game differentiated behaviors have bounded lifetimes, visual warnings and counterplay; no mutation spam or invisible lethal spikes.
12+ minute accelerated simulation includes bosses, varied enemy variants, upgrades and threat controls with finite enemy and projectile counts.
Existing Cataclysm 0.9 companions/abilities, runes, roguelite upgrades, sound, scoring, start/pause/resume/restart and touch/keyboard input remain functional.
Mobile landscape 640x320 and 844x390 and portrait fallback preserve playable readable viewport, HUD and reachable controls; dialogs never strand the player.
Independent runnable QA and exact live deployment/dashboard verification pass, preserving prior 0.9 rollback; if not, fail without changing published game.
